blockers.description: Auto-mode classifier blocks downloading+executing third-party binaries, so tools.install_ffmpeg/install_deno were never run live
blockers.workaround: User tests Install buttons on the Tools page

decisions.decision: Never circumvent DRM, deliberate player obfuscation, or one-time-token-protected streams
decisions.rationale: Same line as DRM; such streams are detected, labelled 'protected' and skipped; other players are tried instead

decisions.decision: Spotify tracks are matched to YouTube uploads instead of downloaded from Spotify
Site mode analyses first (no downloads, no disk writes), then user picks items/folder/format
Episode pages are listed (deferred) and opened only at download time
decisions.rationale: Fast analysis of sites with many episode pages; avoids crawl limits

decisions.decision: Player menu walking only on start page, or on crawled pages when no episode pages are listed
decisions.rationale: Per-season pages often embed players listing other seasons (mislabelling) and repeat work
